A FreeJoy throttle and switch box for your desk

Heat the pad and the pin together for two seconds. Feed solder into the joint, not onto the iron. Take the solder away first, then the iron.

Strip 3 mm, twist the strands, and tin the end before you solder it to a pad.

Unplug USB and disconnect any battery before you solder or change a wire. Work on a surface that does not burn, and wash your hands after handling solder.

Before you switch it on

  1. Look. Every joint is a shiny cone. No solder touches a neighbouring pad. No stray strands of wire.
  2. These must not beep. Set the multimeter to continuity and probe each pair. A beep means a short: find it before you plug in.
    3V3aGND
  3. These must beep. Probe the two ends of every connection.
    3V3aBlue Pill 3V3a · Throttle pot 3 · Mixture pot 3 · Encoder 1 + · Encoder 2 +
    GNDBlue Pill G2 · Throttle pot 1 · Mixture pot 1
    AXIS_THROTTLEBlue Pill A7 · Throttle pot 2
    AXIS_MIXTUREBlue Pill A1 · Mixture pot 2
    GNDBlue Pill G1 · Toggle 1 COM · Toggle 2 COM · Toggle 3 COM · Toggle 4 COM
    TOGGLE_1Blue Pill B12 · Toggle 1 A
    TOGGLE_2Blue Pill B13 · Toggle 2 A
    TOGGLE_3Blue Pill B14 · Toggle 3 A
    TOGGLE_4Blue Pill B15 · Toggle 4 A
    GNDBlue Pill G3 · Encoder 1 GND · Encoder 2 GND · LED 1 (green) K · LED 2 (red) K
    ENC1_ABlue Pill B7 · Encoder 1 CLK
    ENC1_BBlue Pill B8 · Encoder 1 DT
    ENC1_PUSHBlue Pill B9 · Encoder 1 SW
    ENC2_ABlue Pill B10 · Encoder 2 CLK
    ENC2_BBlue Pill B11 · Encoder 2 DT
    ENC2_PUSHBlue Pill B1 · Encoder 2 SW
    LED_1Blue Pill A8 · R1 330 ohm 1
    r1_2R1 330 ohm 2 · LED 1 (green) A
    LED_2Blue Pill B5 · R2 330 ohm 1
    r2_2R2 330 ohm 2 · LED 2 (red) A
  4. Plug in. Nothing gets warm, nothing smells. If something does, unplug at once and go back to step 2.
  5. Flash the bring-up test. It reports every part it can find before you load the real firmware.pio run -e bringup -t upload && pio device monitor
22SPAK-WIRE-1

Spak is built

Spak is a USB game controller for flight simulators, built on a Blue Pill running the open-source FreeJoy firmware. Two lever-ready potentiometers give throttle and mixture axes, four toggles and two push-encoders give switches and trim, and two LEDs follow whatever you map them to. Windows sees it as an ordinary joystick, and every input is set up in the FreeJoy configurator, not in code.
